easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
